name: Pair Fog
description: Lay two small banks of fog on either hand so that a foe cannot tell from which the strike will come.

name: Fog Twin
description: Give an ally a twin of the user's fog so that both move cloaked side by side.

name: Pace Pair
description: Take two quick paces through the paired banks and come out behind the foe.

name: Pair Cut
description: Cut from both banks at once so that the foe's guard can cover only one.

name: Fog Lock
description: Close one bank over the foe's arms and the other over the legs until the foe cannot move.

name: Mirrored Mist
description: Hang a mirrored pair of mist screens before the body so that each turns a blow toward the other.

name: Pair Pall
description: Lay a dank pall between the two banks that rots the strength of any foe who walks in it.

name: Dual Squeeze
description: Squeeze both banks inward on a foe until the foe's every motion slows.

name: Twin Phase
description: Pass through a barrier by going to mist in both banks together and reforming on the far side.

name: Twin Oblivion
description: The school's closing move that closes both banks on a foe so that all sense of self and place is lost with a force that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Judging Mist
description: Let the court mist rise and feel who enters its bounds.

name: Azure Cloak
description: Wear a cloak of azure fog that turns a blow like the cloth of a judge's robe.

name: Verdict Pace
description: Step into the court mist and out again with a measured pace.

name: Fog Writ
description: Serve a writ of cold fog on a foe that binds the foe in place until the court rises.

name: Edict Strike
description: Strike with a fist of azure fog that carries the weight of a ruling.

name: Absolving Dew
description: Let court dew fall on a falsely accused ally and wash off the taint of the charge.

name: Fog Summons
description: Summon a foe out of cover by pulling the fog away from the foe's hiding place.

name: Trial Murk
description: Set a pall of azure fog on the ground that tries every foe who crosses and holds the guilty.

name: Haze Sentence
description: Pass sentence on a foe in the haze and press the foe down under the weight of the ruling.

name: Sudden Vanish
description: Vanish from the dock in an instant and stand again beyond the court's far side.

name: Convened Judgment
description: The school's closing move that convenes the whole court in a wide fog and presses every foe in it to stillness with a weight that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Brume Height
description: Rise above the brume and feel every living thing as a dark shape beneath it.

name: Hawk Drift
description: Drift on the high brume with wings held still.

name: Feather Fog
description: Spread a feathered coat of fog that turns a blade like a wing turns rain.

name: Dive Brume
description: Dive through the brume onto a foe in a falling strike.

name: Brume Cry
description: Cry out through the brume so that the sound seems to come from all sides and breaks a foe's focus.

name: Wing Wash
description: Beat the brume over an ally like a wing and sweep off a clinging poison.

name: Brume Crown
description: Set a crown of brume over a wide ground that hides allies in its shadow and shows foes to the hawk.

name: Stoop Barrage
description: Drop a barrage of brume stoops across a field so that every foe is struck from above.

name: Sky Absorb
description: Take a great blow into the high brume where its force thins away to nothing.

name: Hawk Unseen
description: The school's closing move that drops through the brume unseen and strikes one foe before any sense can mark it with a force that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Vow Haze
description: Breathe a vow into the haze so that a foe who meant harm loses the user's place.

name: Keeper Mist
description: Keep a close mist round the body sworn never to let a blow through while the oath holds.

name: Faith Step
description: Step into the fog on faith in the oath and arrive exactly where it leads.

name: Vow Chain
description: Forge a chain of fog from a broken oath and bind the one who broke it.

name: Vow Blow
description: Strike out of the fog with the weight of a kept vow behind the fist.

name: Oath Draught
description: Give an ally a draught of sworn mist that clears poison and the sickness of broken faith.

name: Oath Murk
description: Raise a pall that lets the faithful through and turns the faithless back to where they began.

name: Pledge Press
description: Press the full pledge of the fog on a foe until the foe kneels.

name: Vow Phase
description: Pass a barrier on the strength of the vow as though it were not there.

name: Oathbound Fog
description: The school's closing move that binds the whole fog to the oath and holds every faithless foe within it with a grip that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Roam Mist
description: Let the mist roam on the wind and learn what it meets.

name: Loose Step
description: Take a loose long step on a wind-fed haze and arrive light.

name: Bare Guard
description: Stand bare in the haze and let it thicken at the exact point of each blow.

name: Haze Sweep
description: Sweep a wind-fed haze across the near ground and buffet every foe in it.

name: Wind Fade
description: Fade a group of allies into the haze on the wind so that they pass unmarked.

name: Haze Cure
description: Cure an ally of a lingering sickness with a clean breath of wind-fed haze.

name: Haze Fray
description: Fray the edges of a foe's technique with a gust of haze so that it loses shape.

name: Open Pall
description: Spread a pall on the wind that thickens wherever a foe turns.

name: Haze Rip
description: Rip a narrow lane through a foe's guard with a spear of wind-fed haze.

name: Haze Streak
description: Streak across the field in a line of haze and stand beside the foe before the foe can turn.

name: Haze Unfenced
description: The school's closing move that lets the haze grow without fence or edge until every foe in it loses all sense of place with a reach that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Freeform Mist
description: Let the mist take any shape it likes so that a foe cannot read what it will do.

name: Spread Thin
description: Spread the body thin across the mist so that a blow finds nothing dense to strike.

name: Drift Wide
description: Drift far and wide on the open mist and settle where the foe has not looked.

name: Mist Tear
description: Tear through a foe's guard with a hand of mist that closes again behind it.

name: Mist Lift
description: Lift a binding or a curse off an ally as mist lifts off morning ground.

name: Edge Scatter
description: Scatter the edges of a foe's formation so that the foe's allies drift apart.

name: Boundless Domain
description: Raise a domain of mist with no wall that fills any ground it is given.

name: Mist Collapse
description: Collapse the whole domain inward and crush every foe in a cold grey weight.

name: Passing Mist
description: Pass through stone and wall alike as mist passes through a net.

name: Mist Everywhere
description: The school's closing move that is the mist everywhere at once so that no foe can find the user or the way out with a reach that scales with the user's reserve.
